description: This source file implements the advanced processing functions for the HTTP Message Body Object, including examination, processing, closing, outputting, and removing encoding. It handles different message states and buffer descriptor management within the message processing pipeline.

methods.name: ULONG HttpMboExamine(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,PVOID buffer,ULONG ulSize)
methods.description: Examines the received payload buffer to determine the message body state after virtually integrating the payload, based on the predicted total body size and current received size.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpMboProcess(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hBdo)
methods.description: Processes a received buffer descriptor, handling different message states, appending buffers, updating states, and notifying relevant parties based on the completeness and packing status of the body.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpMboCloseUp(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hBdo)
methods.description: Handles the final buffer descriptor at connection close, appending any remaining data, updating state, and sending notifications.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpMboOutput(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSerializeContext)
methods.description: Serializes the accumulated message body buffer descriptors for output, using the provided serialization context.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpMboRemoveCoding(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Removes transfer encoding from the message body; currently a placeholder that returns success.
